dependencies: Exact original Radix-based AlertDialog/Label and native Textarea/Button primitive references retained; runtime independently uses React + HTMLDialogElement, no Radix/lucide installed.

dialog.description: Full exact original prose, breaks and mailto:support@example.com retained. No mail link followed in tests.
dialog.identity: One native button trigger, native dialog role alertdialog, real aria-labelledby/describedby; original nested button issue repaired. Original decorative Info glyph replaced by original inline SVG.
dialog.owner: open/defaultOpen exclusive; onOpenChange(next,details) callback returns false to veto; state requests reconcile after owner commit. Callback details.id=dialog-02. Controlled owner commits authoritative, no promise to roll back consumer side effects.
dialog.action: onConfirm/onCancel receive id,event,localOnly:true; false or event.preventDefault vetoes close. Disabled blocks opening and confirm while cancel/Escape remain reachable. No external operation is performed.
dialog.focus: Native showModal modal semantics required; cancel autofocus; native close return focus with newer external focus preservation. Explicit Tab/ShiftTab edge wrapping supplements native within-dialog traversal. Native cancel event and unmodified Escape request dismissal, preserving controlled refusal.
dialog.keyboard: onKeyDownCapture cancellation, composition and modifier guards honored. Native browser remains responsible for ordinary mid-list Tab and true top-layer inertness; not verified by jsdom.
dialog.lifecycle: Unloading closes owned native dialog. Parent disable/unmount/new controlled value supersedes pending requests. Unexpected native close gets one controlled recovery, no infinite loop. Unsupported showModal/close reports visible alert and onNativeError, never silent nonmodal fallback.
dialog.callbacks: Synchronous proposal API, not an asynchronous transaction. Request/action callback side effects are consumer-owned. Ancestor trigger preventDefault cancels pending uncontrolled opening; confirm/cancel consumer veto should be onConfirm/onCancel/onOpenChange.

textarea.meaning: Static invalid example, no automatic validity algorithm or required inference. Typing does not clear error. Caller may explicitly override aria-invalid/description or add required.
textarea.native: Forwarded textarea ref and native onChange/name/form/value/defaultValue/disabled/readOnly/maxLength attributes. value/defaultValue exclusive. Native reset/FormData semantics retained. onChange is observational, not custom cancel callback.
textarea.accessibility: Generated unique id; label association; original static error associated through aria-describedby, merges caller description IDs. Decorative/error styles follow semantic danger tokens.
textarea.unsupported: children/dangerouslySetInnerHTML and onValueChange not public APIs.

visual: Original Follow editorial tokens/local fonts, spare 2px corners, orange Info notice, ink border. Not original pixel equivalence or a Liquid/Pixel skin.
prior82: No old component implementation edited. Native dialog reconciliation approach copied and separately namespaced from reviewed Dialog01; tests/evidence specific to new Dialog02.
tests: React/JSDOM with explicitly documented showModal/close/focus shim; no native browser top-layer/keyboard/inertness/visual acceptance.
